Definition: A unique alphanumeric identifier for this learning opportunity that is used for your customers or for internal processes within your system.
Specifications: Published as a ceterms:IdentifierValue with Identifier Type Name "External Identifier" and the supplied value as its Identifier Value Code. It is also used to group rows for the same learning opportunity.

Definition: Name or title of the resource.
Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
Specifications: Must be a minimum of 15 characters.
Sample: This course guides students in the development of...

Definition: Webpage that describes this entity.
Specifications:
Must be a properly formatted URL beginning in https://

If the source of the course information is a defined catalog, use ceterms:inCatalog instead of ceterms:subjectWebpage.

Definition: Type of state of the resource in terms of its stage in a life cycle; select from an enumeration of such types.
Specifications:
This property requires a value from a controlled vocabulary. Select one of the defined values.

For the initial upload, this would typically be "Active".
Controlled Vocabulary:
Active
Ceased
Ceasing
Developing
Suspended
Teach Out

Definition: The primary language or languages of the entity, even if it makes use of other languages.
Specifications:
Must be a known language name. If there are multiple languages, use a pipe-separated (|) list. 

If no language is provided, the value will default to English.

Definition: Set of alpha-numeric symbols as defined by the body responsible for this resource that uniquely identifies this resource and supports its discovery and use.
Specifications: May be used for course or program codes (ENG 101), or any other bespoke code used by the provider.

Definition: Resource carries or confers no official academic credit according to the provider of the resource.
Specifications: If the learning opportunity is non-credit, enter the value TRUE. Otherwise, leave blank.

Definition: Type of means by which a learning opportunity or assessment is delivered to credential seekers and by which they interact; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
Specifications: This property requires a value from a controlled vocabulary. Select from the list of defined values. For multiple, separate with pipes (|).
Controlled Vocabulary:
Asynchronous
Blended Delivery
In Person
Mixed Synchronous
Online Only
Synchronous
Variable Site

Definition: Detailed description of the delivery type of an assessment or learning opportunity.
Specifications: Use this property if the delivery type described for the course does not match one of the controlled variables in ceterms:deliveryType. The value should be the verbatim text of the delivery type.
Sample: This course includes a mix of delivery types that are designed to fit different schedules.

Definition: An inventory or listing of resources that includes this resource.
Specifications:
Must be a properly formatted URL beginning in https://

Use this property instead of ceterms:subjectWebpage if the source of the course information is a defined catalog.

Definition: Description of the topics, concepts, theories, and practices addressed by a learning opportunity, program, course or assessment.
Sample: Topics covered are mechanical waves, sound, electrostatics, current and DC circuits, magnetism, light and optics, and modern physics.

Definition: Types of methods used to conduct the learning opportunity; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
Specifications: This property requires a value from a controlled vocabulary. Select from the list of defined values. For multiple, separate with pipes (|).
Controlled Vocabulary:
Applied
Apprenticeship
Augmented Reality
Clinical Rotation
Cocurricular Learning
Cohort-Based
Competency Based
Gaming
Instructor-Led
Internship
Laboratory
Lecture
Medical Residency
Prerecorded
Self Paced
Seminar
Simulation
Work Based

Definition: Description of the methods used to conduct learning.
Specifications: Use this property if the learning method described for the course does not match one of the controlled variables in ceterms:learningMethodDescription. The value should be the verbatim text of the learning method.
Sample: This course includes experiential and project-based learning methods.

Definition: Words or brief phrases describing the topicality of the entity; select subject terms from an existing enumeration of such terms.
Specifications: A pipe-separated (|) list of values.

Definition: A credit-related value.
Specifications: Enter the number of credit units awarded for college credit or continuing education units for successful completion of the learning opportunity.

Definition: The value of the property value node.
Specifications: In CTDL: for single values, use schema:value; for ranges, use schema:minValue and schema:maxValue.

Definition: The minimum number of credits.
Specifications: If there is a range of credit units, enter the minimum value in Credit Min Value and the maximum value in this Credit Unit Max Value.

Definition: The maximum number of credits.
Specifications: If there is a range of credit units, enter the minimum value in Credit Value and the maximum value in this property.

Definition: The type of credit associated with the credit awarded or required.
Specifications:
This property requires a value from a controlled vocabulary. Select one of the defined values.

If the unit type is not listed, use Credit Unit Type Description to describe the units.
Controlled Vocabulary:
Academic Unit
Carnegie Unit
Certificate Credit
Clock Hour
Competency Credit
Contact Hour
Continuing Education Unit
Degree Credit
Dual Credit
Quarter Hour
Requirement Credit
Secondary Diploma Credit
Semester Hour
Time Based Credit
Type Based Credit

Definition: Course requirements that are prior conditions to this course.
Specifications:
ceterms:prerequisite has a value of Condition Profile and uses the properties associated with Condition Profile.

Use this property for requirements that are specifically labeled as Prerequisite or use a similar term or abbreviation, such as Pre-req, PR, and so forth.

Definition: Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
Specifications:
Use this property for the verbatim textual description of the prerequisite.

Examples:
MATH 124
MATH 124 or higher
MATH 124 and 125
BIOL 219 with a minimum grade of C-
70% score on Information Technology Qualifying Exam and MATH 11003
Consent of the instructor
Students in the Honors Program and consent by the honors director
Sample: BIOL 219 with a minimum grade of C-

Definition: Learning opportunity that is the focus of a condition, process or another learning opportunity.
Specifications: Use this property to list the specific course objects that are included in the prerequisite, using External Identifier(s) as the value(s).

Definition: Resources that must be pursued concurrently.
Specifications:
ceterms:corequisite has a value of Condition Profile and uses the properties associated with Condition Profile.

Use this property for requirements that are specifically labeled as Corequisite or use a similar term or abbreviation, such as concurrent, concurrent enrollment, CR, and so forth.

Definition: Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
Specifications:
Use this property for the verbatim textual description of the corequisite.

Examples:
MATH 124
MATH 124 or MATH 125

Definition: Learning opportunity that is the focus of a condition, process or another learning opportunity.
Specifications: Use this property to list the specific course objects that are included in the corequisite, using External Identifier(s) as the value(s).

Definition: Resource that must be completed prior to, or pursued at the same time as, this resource.
Specifications:
ceterms:coPrequisite has a value of Condition Profile and uses the properties associated with Condition Profile.

Use this property when a course specifically requires a Co-Prerequisite, and when the course identifies a resource that can be either a Prerequisite or a Corequisite.

Definition: Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
Specifications:
Use this property for the verbatim textual description of the Co-Prerequisite.

Examples:
MATH 124
Prerequisite or Corequisite: BIOL 30883
Pre- or Corequisite: CHEM 14103 or CHEM 12073
Sample: Pre- or Corequisite: CHEM 14103 or CHEM 12073

Definition: Learning opportunity that is the focus of a condition, process or another learning opportunity.
Specifications: Use this property to list the specific course objects that are included in the Co-Prerequisite, using External Identifier(s) as the value(s).

Definition: Indicates a resource that it is advisable to earn or complete before attempting the resource being described.
Specifications:
ceterms:recommends has a value of Condition Profile and uses the properties associated with Condition Profile.

Use this property for information that is recommended but not required. This information may be identified "advisory", "recommended", or "recommended preparation".

Definition: Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
Specifications: Use this property for the verbatim textual information that is recommended, advisory, or suggested.
Sample: Intermediate algebra or higher or ET 108A

Definition: Learning opportunity that is the focus of a condition, process or another learning opportunity.
Specifications: Use this property to list the specific course objects that are included in the recommended, advisory, or suggested information, using External Identifier(s) as the value(s).

Definition: Requirements for entry into a credentialing program, a learning opportunity, or an assessment, including credentials, transcripts, records of previous experience, or other forms of entry documentation.
Specifications:
ceterms:entryCondition has a value of Condition Profile and uses the properties associated with Condition Profile.

Use this property for requirements for entry, enrollment, or participation in a Course that are not Prerequisites, Corequisites, Co-Prerequisites, or recommendations.

Definition: Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
Specifications: Use this property for the verbatim textual information that is specified in the Entry Condition.
Sample: LIMITATION ON ENROLLMENT: To participate in work experience education, students must ...

Definition: Learning opportunity that is the focus of a condition, process or another learning opportunity.
Specifications: Use this property to list the specific course objects that are included in the Entry Condition, using External Identifier(s) as the value(s).

Definition: Estimated time it will take to complete an activity, event, or resource.
Specifications:
ceterms:estimatedDuration has a value of Duration Profile and uses the properties associated with Duration Profile.

Use this property to describe time-based values associated with the course. This may include, among other things:
In class hours
Out-of-class hours
Contact hours
Lecture hours
Lab hours

A course may list multiple time-based values, in which case there should be multiple Duration Profiles.

Definition: Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
Specifications:
Use this property for the verbatim textual description of the time-based values.

Examples:
Course In-Class (Contact) Hours
Course Out-of-Class Hours
Course Lecture Hours
Course Lab Hours

Definition: Overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
Specifications: This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.

Definition: Minimum overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
Specifications: This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.

Definition: Maximum overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
Specifications: This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.

Definition: Total engaged or participating time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
Specifications:
This is intended to indicate only the sum of the individual amounts of time which are spent actively engaged in pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource, regardless of the overall time span required to complete it.

For Course, this would typically be indicated in hours.
